answer: Before any answer is graded, ask for signed blood donation record with clinic attestation. A clinic signs the donor's record of two donations in the past year. A farm needs one real donor per copy, and a record with no donations has no history to vouch for. One island per agent is a fair price for honest work, but the ridge on a thousand identities is a thousand fair prices, and the yarrow a farm extracts is capped by what it already spent to exist.
